title: Requirement→code mapping precision/recall vs replayed PRs
note: Self-contained fixture (Issue #738, Epic #726). repo/ files are parsed by METIS's own parseSource to build an in-memory code graph. Each case is a 'replayed PR': a requirement description whose changedFiles are the files the real PR actually touched (the RELEVANT set). The eval runs the B2 deterministic path (mapRequirementToCode + blastRadius via computeProjectImpact) and scores the predicted affected-file set (the RETRIEVED set) against changedFiles. edges[] snapshot the call sites the blast radius walks (getEdgesTo => upstream callers), so a changed caller file can be recovered transitively. Everything is offline: no network, no DB, no LLM, no embedder. Symbol names carry the discriminating tokens because BM25 indexes name/qualifiedName (not filePath).

cases.requirement: Change the payment processing fee to a tiered fee schedule and update every checkout call site.
Send an order confirmation email to the customer whenever a new order is created.
Support partial refunds and notify the customer by email about each refund.
Reserve inventory stock when an order is placed and release the reserved stock when the order is cancelled.
Validate the user session during checkout before creating the order.
